implementation.ordinaryModes: Named Map interaction mode group; text labels; aria-pressed state plus check glyph; focusable native buttons.
implementation.phoneModeDisclosure: Accessible name includes the current interaction mode; aria-expanded and aria-controls expose its menu state.
implementation.viewDisclosure: Named Map view options button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; labelled Result visualization and View context groups.
implementation.layersDisclosure: Named Map layers button with aria-expanded and aria-controls; Escape returns focus to the trigger.
implementation.selectors: Radio-quality metric, Ray scope, and Map focus remain native labelled select controls.
implementation.specialMode: role=status with polite live announcement, descriptive mode name, map action instruction, and explicit Finish/Cancel controls where applicable.
implementation.mapKey: Named Map key region; native disclosure button; collapsed contents carry the hidden attribute and CSS explicitly respects it.
implementation.inspect: Entity identity and facts remain available in the named contextual inspector; removal of the legacy Cell popup does not remove inspector identity.
implementation.tooltips: Remaining icon-only map actions have accessible names and title text; Inspect and Select cells remain text-labelled.

keyboardEvidence.assertion: Escape closes the View group and restores focus to Map view options; menu focus behavior is exercised.
Enter activates conditional Inspect focused cell, inspector receives focus, Escape closes it, and focus returns to Map view options.

keyboardEvidence.test: E2E keyboard disclosure navigation without RF work
keyboardEvidence.assertion: Existing disclosure/keyboard workflow remains available without starting RF requests.

responsiveEvidence: At 390px, current mode, View, and Layers remain visible in one 42px toolbar row; the interaction menu exposes Select cells and Draw area. Evidence is in concept-8c-responsive-evidence.json and its linked captures.
limits: Automated DOM, accessibility-role, keyboard, and focus-return checks were run; no manual screen-reader certification was performed.
Map features retain the existing interaction/accessibility model; Concept 8C does not add keyboard navigation among Leaflet features.
